subject: Energy
title: Storage Deployment Trends
description: A quick win: understand Storage Deployment Trends.

hook.text: Global battery storage installations are doubling annually—exceeding 45 GW/100 GWh of cumulative capacity in 2023.

buildup.text: China leads installations with over 60% of new deployments—followed by the US and Europe.

discovery.text: Most systems are paired with solar farms—co-locating generation and storage to maximize value and reduce cost.

twist.text: Residential batteries are growing fast—homeowners want backup power and energy independence, not just savings.

climax.text: BloombergNEF predicts 1 TWh of annual deployments by 2030—a tenfold increase from current levels.

punchline.text: Doubling every year—storage is the fastest-growing energy tech.

quiz.question: Which country leads in new battery storage deployments?
